previous_versions.body:
I agree this is a really important topic and something we need to be careful about.

The first thing to make clear is that from now on we should have each release tagged to make it easier to test to a particular version. E.g. you can get the static 4.0.1 version from: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/tree/v4.0.1.

The master branch is by design the "bleeding edge" version so should probably not used if you need standardisation.

My thought in theory would be that we should change the 3rd number, e.g., 4.0.2, 4.0.3, for minor changes/fixes to content where req numbers do not change, change the 2nd number, e.g. 4.1, 4.2, if req numbers have changed and change the 1st number when we next do a major revamp in a few years (5.x, 6.x).

In practice, that might be complicated to implement but it is something to think about.

In the meantime, I hope that we can get a 4.1 released in the next few months.
